passage /passage?ref=Matthew%205&version: PHP single_heading bug: passage_script.php drops the first verse (or verse part) of every section after the first, e.g. Matthew 5:2b, 13, 17, 21. Node keeps all verses and shows only the first heading.
html /%2eenv: Locally the search runs on the MySQL fallback, which stops at its time budget (SEARCH_FALLBACK_MAX_MS) before finishing a scan for a short word and says "Showing partial results". Same 0 results; production searches through Sphinx, which has no budget.
html re:^/(search/)?[^/?]*(%22|\")[^/?]*: Live returns no results for quoted phrases (PHP breaks the quotes before querying Sphinx); Node searches the phrase, as Sphinx does — owner decision 2026-10-20
asset /css/style.css: Goudy Old Style is proprietary; served from a private FONT_BASE (owner decision 2026-10-20). Its @font-face rules are gone from style.css; the layout declares the licensed 'Goudy Scripture' only when FONT_BASE or FONT_DIR is set, and the body stack is 'Goudy Scripture', 'Sorts Mill Goudy', Georgia, serif (live: 'Sorts Mill Goudy', 'Goudy', …)
markdown live:^<br />\\s*<b>Fatal error<: Live markdown is a PHP fatal-error page for every request (renderMarkdown called with too few arguments), exposing server paths; Node renders the format
xml live:^<br />\\s*<b>Fatal error</b>:: Live xml is a PHP fatal-error page for every request (renderXMLElement called with too few arguments), exposing server paths; Node renders the format
html re:^/([A-Za-z0-9*.]+/)?(\\d+|[1-4]?: Subverse letter on a reference-shaped path (book.chapter.verse or a verse id, then one letter: john.3.16a, kjv/1ne.3.7b, fax/1879l): PHP's /\d[a-z]$/ drops the digit with the letter (john.3.16a is John 3:1); Node keeps the verse — owner decision not to reproduce
html live:<title>Genesis 1–50Exodus: Live expands unbounded multi-book ranges from junk URLs; Node caps the range to protect the server (controller decision 2026-10-20). Live's title here lists every book from Genesis 1 on: a range whose unresolved start PHP read as verse 1 (junk paths shaped /<word>/<word>-<word><digit>, about 2 MB). Node expands at most 1000 verses (the package's own limit) and shows the block as not found
